title: •Flagship Operations
caption: •Flagship Operations (V)
game_text: Deploy on a system. Your TIEs may relocate (as a regular move) to a system from 0 to 3 parsecs away. For each battleground system you control with two TIEs piloted by Imperials, you may add 3 to your total power in battles. Opponent’s Force drain is +3 here. {alter}
